newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Henare says NZF doors open for Alliance's Koopu.
newsitem.headline: Henare says NZF doors open for Alliance's Koopu.

text.p: Tau Henare, deputy leader of New Zealand First, said on Thursday the party would welcome an approach from Alliance Maori list MP Alamein Koopu, amid speculation that she may be dropped from the leftwing group.
"This is a personal message from me as the deputy leader of New Zealand First -- if she wanted to join NZF the doors are always open," Henare said in a statement.
"Even if she were to go independent I personally would support her in her efforts," he added.
NZF said it believed the Alliance was considering Koopu's future and there was "every indication" the party was about to drop her as one of its representatives in parliament.
